methodology: Each map was audited blind against the selected artifact, then compared with the sealed approved historical report. When a miss occurred, the earliest existing mechanism was repaired and the map rerun.

unseenMaps.repair: Developer-Item Acquisition Graph + Evidence Receipt Gate
Cooperative Participant Accounting + mandatory developer crafting closure
Player Capability Model / Creative acquisition surface
Transactional Referential Integrity + Active-Session Reload Recovery
Mandatory Replica Discovery in base discovery

unseenMaps.map: Five Nights at Z Village L1

interpretation.positive: All eight sealed historical issues are now representable and detected after targeted repairs without adding new issue taxonomy families.
interpretation.limitation: Initial blind recall across these six unseen maps was 0/8. Therefore the engine is improving through regression-guided generalization, but current evidence does not justify claiming universal first-pass recall.
interpretation.nextAcceptanceGoal: Run at least one additional unseen map without changing the engine. A clean first-pass recall result is stronger evidence of generalization than another repair-driven 100% rerun.
